messages.subject: Hosting Shiny App
parts:
From the shiny tutorial

"our Shiny app happens to be one of the most widely used communication tools in the world: a web page. If you host the app at its own URL, users can visit the app (and not need to worry about code).

If you are familiar with web hosting or have access to an IT department, you can host your Shiny apps yourself."


Sorry if this is a silly question, but can somebody explain to me how exactly one does this?
